_help: Design 30 Sept §BO: the fantastical folk are dressings on a way of life, our own folklore, ALL friendly (the dark is the only antagonist). A people file's folk_kinds says which kinds tend to live that life. Silhouette notes are for the rig; the cloaked_figure rig is the base.

goblin.silhouette: short, long-armed, big ears under the hood; folk_scale 0.75
goblin.note: already in the repo as the tribal folk; at home in marsh, karst and rock shelter

orc.note: friendly: the player braces and nothing happens. Steppe, mountain, savanna

fae.silhouette: slight, folk_scale 0.85, a faint light at the hood at night
fae.note: old growth, lake, tropical forest; kin to the bog wisp and the small folk in creatures.json

small_folk.note: creatures.json Parvulus lucernifer; hills, old growth
